about: Licence texts read from their published pages, for crates and npm packages that ship none: each at the commit its version was published from (a crate's .cargo_vcs_info.json, an npm package's gitHead in its registry entry), read on the date given - the top one where an entry gives none; and, under `carried`, the licences of code by others that an npm package carries in its own files without them. scripts/licenses/notices.mjs gives them in the notices.

also.what: The MIT License's terms, as the page its licence file links to gives them. Its repository gives no copyright line of its own: its authors are as its Cargo.toml names them, above.

carried.what: Typr.ts's licence, as its repository holds it at the commit @lojjic/typr 0.3.8-lojjic1 was published from (a6d43bacc0cc1fce913023f9ccb8622c2ceb1c00): the build of Typr.ts its package.json names for libs/typr.factory.js.
